entries.label: N=47 Canonical
entries.methodology: Production M4 evaluation: live 4H bars, EMA carry-forward, override history, D6_VIX_ROC gate, 27-ticker canonical universe. Locked baseline_n from module_baselines table.

entries.label: N=57 S44-V0
entries.source_script: scripts/m4_backtest_5yr.py (S44 research sprint, V0 streak def)
entries.methodology: S44 streak sensitivity V0: streak = close<open (3 consecutive 4H bars), 25-ticker universe (includes SNOW/TXN/IBIT, pre-canonical), D6_VIX_ROC gate NOT applied, prior-day VIX>=25, RSI<35.
entries.relationship_to_canonical: DIFFERENT methodology: pre-D6 filter, different streak definition, different ticker universe. Research artifact, not canonical.

entries.label: N=264/28 Counterfactual
entries.methodology: Standalone production-mirror harness on local 5yr M5 data. HARN-1.1 applies: ~6.7x under-fire vs production. N=264 from VLog 303 §6 likely includes broader sweep signals. Local enriched CSV has N=28 (canonical gates, standalone harness).
entries.relationship_to_canonical: DIFFERENT execution environment (HARN-1.1). Not comparable to N=47 canonical. Standalone harness fires ~7 triggers per 5yr run vs 47 in production.

entries.label: N=4-8 VIX Threshold Sweep
entries.methodology: Same standalone harness as above, swept across VIX_GATE in [20,22,23,24,25,26,28,30]. At VIX_GATE=25: N=7. Range N=4-8 across all thresholds. HARN-1.1 ratio: 47/7 ≈ 6.7, confirming HARN-1.1 under-fire.
entries.relationship_to_canonical: DIFFERENT execution environment (HARN-1.1). N=7 at canonical VIX_GATE=25.0 confirms HARN-1.1 ratio ~6.7x.

summary: 4 N-values reconciled: N=47 (canonical production), N=57 (S44 V0 research), N=264/28 (standalone harness counterfactual), N=4-8 (standalone harness VIX sweep). Each attributed to distinct source and methodology. HARN-1.1 explains standalone-vs-production discrepancy.
